svg.title: Practical knowledge / חכמות מעשיות
svg.desc: Chapter 11, Hebrew pp237–241, English pp238–242. The established Purpose flag accompanies the established Means wrench. Practical knowledge teaches how to carry out an art: explain the intended end first, then the required means. Ramchal gives grammar and calendar calculation, so the category is not limited to manual crafts or physical tools. No success is asserted.
